note: The narration, one entry per spoken line. Edit here, then re-run justinclips/tools/shortbuild.py. '...' = a held beat before the punchline. Years/numbers stay digits (the D2 tool spells them for the TTS; captions keep digits).

lines.text: Rats once got sued. And they got a lawyer.
France, the early 1500s. Rats reportedly ate the barley around Autun.
So a court summoned the rats.
The rats... did not show up.
Their lawyer said that was unfair: his clients lived in lots of villages.
Then he said they couldn't come safely... because of the town's cats.
He wanted the cats kept indoors. The owners said no.
So the case was reportedly thrown out.
